rationale: Retain one active American Natural record, but correct its perimeter to the American Natural Supply fuel-terminal, storage and distribution-logistics business retained by Cleopatra Resources LLC after the December 2023 sale of substantially all retail assets to Giant Oil. Tiger Infrastructure Partners' May 2015 investment and current involvement are evidenced, but the exact fund, acquisition vehicle, security, ownership percentage and current co-investors are not publicly disclosed; remove the unsupported Fund I attribution rather than infer those facts.

companyFieldUpdates.subsector: Fuel terminals, storage and distribution logistics
companyFieldUpdates.description: American Natural is the Tiger-backed fuel-infrastructure platform held through Cleopatra Resources LLC and now centered on American Natural Supply. The retained business provides commercial fuel supply, storage, terminal, delivery and logistics services to commercial, industrial and Marcellus/Utica customers. Tiger closed its investment in May 2015, but the exact fund, vehicle, security and ownership percentage are not publicly disclosed. American Natural Supply acquired key Satterlee assets in 2017, and Cleopatra sold substantially all American Natural Retail PA assets to Giant Oil in December 2023; those divested retail locations are outside the retained platform perimeter.
